blocks.content: Here's the syntax of a switch statement.
The switch statement starts with the switch keyword followed by a variable or an expression inside the parentheses.
If the variable/expression doesn't match the value of any case, the default case is executed.
Note: We have used the break statement after each case to terminate the switch statement once the case is executed. We will see what happens if we don't include a break inside each case.
